queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, avg_unit_price - AVG(avg_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation FROM inv), cd AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_avg FROM dev), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (deviation_minus_country_avg IS NULL), deviation_minus_country_avg DESC) AS rk FROM cd) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, deviation_minus_country_avg FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY rk, InvoiceId

assumptions.assumption: Country means Customer.Country (the customer's country, as the request states), not Invoice.BillingCountry.
Invoices with no invoice lines are kept with a NULL average. NULLs are ignored in the overall and country averages and sorted last.
The invoice average is the plain average of line UnitPrice, not weighted by Quantity.
Ties with the 10th row are included using RANK(). Rows with a NULL country form their own group for the country average.

assumptions.assumption: The average unit price of an invoice is the plain AVG(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice) over its lines, not weighted by Quantity.
The country is the customer's Customer.Country, not Invoice.BillingCountry.
Invoices with no lines are kept with a NULL average (LEFT JOIN). The overall and country averages ignore NULLs, and these invoices sort last.
Ties with the 10th row are included by using RANK() <= 10.

responses.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), fin AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS dev_minus_country_avg FROM dev), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (dev_minus_country_avg IS NULL), dev_minus_country_avg DESC) AS rnk FROM fin) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, dev_minus_country_avg FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY rnk, InvoiceId;

assumptions.assumption: Country is the customer's Customer.Country, not Invoice.BillingCountry, since the request says the customer's country.
The invoice average is the simple average of InvoiceLine.UnitPrice per line, not weighted by Quantity.
Invoices with no lines are kept with a NULL average. They are ignored in the overall and country averages and sort last. This matches the 'blanks last' wording.
Ties with the 10th row are included by using RANK() and keeping rank <= 10.
